firm_data.firm_description: Adler & Stachenfeld LLP is a law firm focused on real estate law. The firm represents clients throughout all levels of the equity and debt capital stacks in the real estate industry.
notable_facts: The firm is known as The Pure Play in Real Estate Law.
A&S focuses on helping clients grow their real estate businesses.
The firm has a blue-chip client base, including NYC developers, investment funds, and public companies.

email.subject: AI for Adler & Stachenfeld, built for real estate practices
email.body:
Hi Terri,

As managing partner of The Pure Play in Real Estate Law, you're navigating deals across the full equity and debt capital stacks, which means your team juggles complex transactions that demand precision and speed. That's exactly where we see the biggest gap.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
